import MeasureTheory.Integrable
open MeasureTheory

theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {t : ℝ}
  (ht_int_pos : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ)
  (ht_int_neg : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (-t * X ω)) μ) :
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|)) μ := by
  have h_exp_bound : ∀ ω, Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|) ≤ max (Real.exp (t * X ω)) (Real.exp (-t * X ω)) :=
    fun ω => by
      rw [Real.abs_mul, Real.abs_eq_max]
      exact Real.exp_le_max (t * X ω) (-t * X ω)
  have h_max_integrable : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => max (Real.exp (t * X ω)) (Real.exp (-t * X ω))) μ :=
    by
      let f := fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)
      let g := fun ω => Real.exp (-t * X ω)
      have hf : Integrable f μ := ht_int_pos
      have hg : Integrable g μ := ht_int_neg
      exact (Integrable.max hf hg)
  exact h_max_integrable.mp h_exp_bound
